STYLE.world: Handcrafted mixed-media tabletop diorama of a whimsical folk art miniature world

STYLE.real_nature: Real miniature moss, authentic damp earth, dried golden oak leaves, natural sunlight

CHARACTERS.dna: Stylized wooden folk art figurine, tall slender proportions, turned wooden head with styled hair under headwear, minimalist face without blushed cheeks, articulated hands

figure_1.head: Softly rectangular wooden head, chestnut wool hair under a tweed flat cap
figure_1.attire: Slate tweed vest, rolled linen sleeves, tailored charcoal wool trousers falling straight to small leather boots
figure_1.action: Using delicate carved wooden hands to break open a steaming roasted sweet potato in parchment wrap
figure_1.gaze: Gentle downward focus on the warm food

figure_2.head: Slender oval wooden head, auburn yarn hair under a knit beret
figure_2.attire: Oatmeal pressed felt coat, pleated wool skirt falling straight to small leather boots
figure_2.action: Reaching out both hands gently to accept half of the sweet potato
figure_2.gaze: Serene painted smile line, looking with affection at companion

ENVIRONMENT.setting: Curved pathway in a miniature autumn village park
ENVIRONMENT.focal_elements: Handcrafted curved timber park bench with fine woodgrain and brass rivets
ENVIRONMENT.staging: figure_1 seated center-left and figure_2 seated center-right side-by-side on the curved timber bench, facing slightly toward each other; both of their feet firmly planted on the gravel path
ENVIRONMENT.backdrop: Softly blurred ancient oak tree and distant timber cottage gables
ENVIRONMENT.real_nature: Real damp earth, scattered dry golden oak leaves, mossy stone basin
ENVIRONMENT.lighting: Warm low golden-hour backlight casting soft elongated shadows across gravel
ENVIRONMENT.motion: Puffs of delicate white steam rising into the crisp autumn air

SURREAL.quirk: Whimsical organic curved timber street lamp posts shaped like delicate fiddlehead ferns
